title: File:Wrist-oximeter.jpg
desc:
Picture of a wrist mounted pulse oxymeter. The sensor is attached to the finger which in turn is attached to the device via a cable.
The device shows the oxygenation of the blood, the pulse rate and the pulse waveform along with several indicators of device specific information.
